job.title: Clinical Governance Business Partner
job.description:
Company Description:

You can help bring our villages to life!

At Summerset, from the moment we start developing a village, to when our residents call it home, it’s the passion and dedication of our people that brings our villages to life. We are one team, united by being part of something bigger – to bring the best of life to our residents.

Job Description:

This national role will strengthen our clinical governance, compliance and quality systems while supporting village teams to deliver safe, consistent and people-centred care. You will provide national clinical leadership through your expertise, influence and close partnership with village teams and leaders. You will also help prepare provider registration variations, new residential care services for commissioning and opening and lead performance audits as our Australian portfolio grows.

Based at our St Kilda office, this role offers a blended working arrangement across the office, our villages and home. You will spend one day each week at each operating village, supporting Cranbourne North, Chirnside Park and Oakleigh South so flexibility to travel regularly is required.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Lead and strengthen clinical governance and quality frameworks across our Australian operations.
  • Ensure clinical systems and practices meet Australian aged care legislation, regulatory requirements and quality standards.
  • Keep villages audit-ready and oversee actions arising from reviews, audits and regulatory activity.
  • Use clinical data, incidents, complaints and audit findings to identify risk and drive measurable improvement.
  • Develop and maintain clinical policies, procedures, training and education programmes.
  • Coach and mentor village leaders and clinical teams to embed evidence-based, person-centred care.
  • Lead clinical readiness for new services, including commissioning, registration and early operational monitoring.
  • Contribute to Australian and trans-Tasman clinical governance forums, reporting and continuous improvement initiatives.

Please click here to view position description.

Qualifications:

About You

You are an experienced clinical governance or aged care leader who combines regulatory rigour with a practical, supportive approach. You are comfortable moving between strategic frameworks, policy, clinical risk and hands-on implementation in our villages.

  • Current registration as a Registered Nurse with the Nursing and Midwifery Board of Australia
  • At least five years of experience in senior aged care management, clinical governance, quality or compliance.
  • Strong knowledge of Australian aged care legislation, regulatory requirements and quality standards.
  • Proven experience managing clinical governance, quality, audit, risk or compliance frameworks.
  • Experience developing clinical policies, training programs and practical quality improvement initiatives.
  • Strong coaching and influencing skills, with the credibility to lead through expertise and partnership.
  • Ability to turn clinical data, incidents, complaints and audit findings into practical action.
  • Experience commissioning and preparing a new aged care service for accreditation or registration for operational readiness.
  • Flexibility to travel weekly between St Kilda and our Victorian villages, with broader travel as the portfolio grows.

Additional Information:

Why join us?

If you want to combine national influence with practical village support and help shape the next stage of Summerset's Australian growth, we would love to hear from you.

We also offer a competitive salary and a range of benefits on offer including flexible working, an annual entitlement of Summerset shares, long service leave, a day off on your birthday and much more!

Next Steps: Applications for this role will close on Thursday, 3 December 2026 . This role may close early due to a high volume of applications, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible to avoid disappointment.
